name: Glenwood's (Stanford Grill - Columbia)

sources.notes: Official Columbia location page confirms the former Stanford Grill location, address, phone, hours, and direct menu/order links.
Restaurant-linked Columbia Toast surface fully enumerates the current lunch, feature, side, dessert, and to-go beverage catalog with explicit allergen and accommodation labels.
Officially linked OpenTable surface corroborates the current Columbia lunch menu, cocktails, identity, and rename from Stanford Grill.
Current merchant delivery listing corroborates dinner-category products including Jumbo Lump Crabcakes.
Targeted search found the official gluten-free menu link but no exhaustive product-by-allergen matrix.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.claim: Toast publishes explicit positive contains/contact/accommodation labels for many products but no exhaustive matrix covering every allergen and every product; undeclared allergens are not treated as absent.

summary: Glenwood's Columbia current location-specific ordering and reservation surfaces enumerate 76 distinct lunch, feature, dinner-corroborated, side, dessert, beverage, and cocktail products. Of 57 frozen rows, 29 match exactly, 3 normalize to renamed/current presentations, 1 is a category-heading artifact, and 24 older dishes or wine labels are stale. No exhaustive allergen matrix was found; explicit positive Toast allergen labels were retained without treating silence as allergen-free.
